scope: Read-only review of B01 testability, oracle independence, source fidelity, and conditional controls UI gate skip. No product or test code was implemented.

blocking_findings_resolved_in_reviewed_p: Snapshot identity binds raw workflow, state-contract, and agent-contract SHA256 values in a versioned bundle.
Real-mode incompleteness rules explicitly name the five collections; all release modes share the same rule and fixed marker policy.
The conditional UI-gate omission pins the accepted controls archive, report, review, gate, source inventory, and build/plugin artifacts; equality is required or the full 11-command gate runs.

accepted_controls_baseline.scope: Accepted synthetic controls UI baseline only; not B01 or original acceptance evidence.

original_scope.details: The plan matches B01's workflow registry, validators, and immutable profile snapshot deliverable. It keeps B02 authorization/database/workspaces and B03 durable execution separate, preserves the AX GET-only server boundary, and retains AT-04 and AT-28 as not executed.

resolved_prior_blockers.details: The new plan binds the immutable reference to the three original contract byte hashes; defines the five real-mode empty-array rules and placeholder markers without making release-mode exceptions; and names the accepted controls evidence and exact UI/source/build pins for the conditional gate omission.

testability_and_oracle_independence.details: The public exports and fixed error-code families give tests observable contracts. The injectable fs/promises-compatible seam permits deterministic barriers and single-boundary faults while independent child processes exercise real link and directory-sync races. The plan explicitly prohibits using validator fields or decisions as the expected-value oracle and assigns TC-owned literal fixtures and hash vectors.

required_test_coverage: P1: independent valid example/mock and real fixtures; missing/null/extra/type/enum and boolean cases; each release mode; empty-array and marker completeness; duplicate and escaped-duplicate keys; UTF-8 errors; root/type errors; depth 64/65 and byte limit boundary; exact issue ordering and safe DTO output.

P2: raw source pins and bundle identity; canonical key-order versus array-order vectors; profile and whole-payload digests; project/version/workflow rebinding and conflict; snapshot filename identity; caller mutation after invocation; deep-frozen detached return values; corrupt and mismatched records.

P3: separate-process same-key equal and conflicting publications; pre-directory-sync EEXIST barrier; temp write/file-sync/close/link/directory-sync faults; post-link uncertain result and idempotent recovery; no rollback or overwrite; orphan temp isolation; symlink, non-directory, oversized, corrupt, and wrong-identity final records.

P4: subprocess CLI exit 0/2/3 matrix, valid and invalid flag combinations, default example, require-real-config, snapshot/read/init; stdout/stderr exact allowlisted DTOs with path/secret sentinels; no network, child execution, hardware, publisher, or transcript API effects.

P5: prove the 169-source inventory and 10 build/plugin outputs against the accepted candidate before omitting the existing UI gate; otherwise run all 11 commands. Preserve intended Ajv/package-lock-only changes with explicit review and verify imported originals remain byte-identical.

profile_schema_boundary.details: The document correctly treats the field-level JSON Schema as a new implementation contract, not an original schema. Exact object fields, enums, required booleans, string behavior, collection completeness, parser limits, and stable issue/error DTOs are specified sufficiently for fixed independent expected values.

fault_and_concurrency_oracle.details: The file seam plus actual subprocesses can verify the planned atomicity and race outcomes. These tests establish process-level behavior on the stated Node 24/Linux local-filesystem target; they cannot establish power-loss durability, multiuser authorization, or distributed filesystem semantics, which the plan explicitly leaves outside scope.

conditional_ui_gate_skip.details: The skip is acceptable only when current relevant source inventory and built frontend/plugin outputs match the pinned accepted candidate. Any mismatch, import into protected runtime paths, or UI/replay/server behavior change requires the full 11-command gate. This review does not pre-approve that later equality result.

implementation_gate.reason: The reviewed plan itself requires both plan-review-v2.json and this TC review to approve the exact plan SHA before product implementation. This record approves only TC feasibility and oracle coverage.

remaining_acceptance_boundary.AT-04: not_executed; B01 preflight does not implement X01 same-baseline skip approval/evidence behavior.
remaining_acceptance_boundary.AT-28: not_executed; B01 mock/profile mechanics cannot establish real-release enforcement.
remaining_acceptance_boundary.B02_to_B13: remain separately tracked; this review does not accept their implementation.
remaining_acceptance_boundary.power_loss_or_production_storage: not proven by process-fault tests or local hashes.
remaining_acceptance_boundary.original_source_modification: none permitted; workflow/state/agent/profile example and imported design package remain immutable inputs.

reviewer_verdict: Approve the TC plan for the exact SHA above. Product implementation remains gated on the separately required plan-review-v2 approval against the same SHA.
